sanskrit:
मात्रास्पर्शास्तु कौन्तेय शीतोष्णसुखदुःखदाः ।
आगमापायिनोऽनित्यास्तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत ॥
english: Heat and cold, pleasure and pain come from the senses meeting the world. They come and they go; none of them lasts. Bear them with patience.
meaning: Good times and hard times both pass. Stay patient through them.

sanskrit:
विषादप्यमृतं ग्राह्यममेध्यादपि काञ्चनम् ।
अमित्रादपि सद्वृत्तं बालादपि सुभाषितम् ॥
english: Take nectar even from poison, gold even from dirt, good conduct even from a rival, and wise words even from a child.
meaning: Learn what is good from anyone, wherever it comes from.

sanskrit:
स वै पुंसां परो धर्मो यतो भक्तिरधोक्षजे ।
अहैतुक्यप्रतिहता ययात्मा सुप्रसीदति ॥
english: The highest dharma for anyone is the one that awakens selfless, unbroken devotion to the Divine. Through it, the self becomes truly at peace.
meaning: Real peace comes from love that asks for nothing back.

sanskrit:
नेहाभिक्रमनाशोऽस्ति प्रत्यवायो न विद्यते ।
स्वल्पमप्यस्य धर्मस्य त्रायते महतो भयात् ॥
english: On this path no effort is ever lost, and nothing you do here works against you. Even a little of it protects you from great fear.
meaning: No sincere step toward good is ever wasted.

sanskrit:
परोक्षे कार्यहन्तारं प्रत्यक्षे प्रियवादिनम् ।
वर्जयेत्तादृशं मित्रं विषकुम्भं पयोमुखम् ॥
english: Steer clear of a friend who undoes your work behind your back and speaks sweetly to your face: a pot of poison with milk on top.
meaning: Be wary of people who flatter you but work against you.

sanskrit:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥
english: Your right is to the work alone, never to its fruits. Don't let results be your reason for acting, and don't let that turn you toward doing nothing.
meaning: Do your best work and let go of worrying about the outcome.

sanskrit:
मनसा चिन्तितं कार्यं वाचा नैव प्रकाशयेत् ।
मन्त्रेण रक्षयेद्गूढं कार्ये चापि नियोजयेत् ॥
english: What you have planned in your mind, don't announce in words. Guard it quietly with careful thought, and then put it into action.
meaning: Keep your plans to yourself until you act on them.

sanskrit:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥
english: Rooted in yourself, do your work and let go of clinging. Stay the same in success and failure. That evenness is what yoga means.
meaning: Do the work calmly, the same whether it succeeds or fails.

sanskrit:
उत्तमैः सह साङ्गत्यं पण्डितैः सह सत्कथाम् ।
अलुब्धैः सह मित्रत्वं कुर्वाणो नावसीदति ॥
english: One who keeps company with the noble, good conversation with the wise and friendship with the unselfish never comes to grief.
meaning: Good company keeps you out of trouble.

sanskrit:
शैले शैले च माणिक्यं मौक्तिकं न गजे गजे ।
साधवो न हि सर्वत्र चन्दनं न वने वने ॥
english: Not every mountain holds rubies, not every elephant a pearl, not every forest sandalwood. Good people, too, are not found everywhere.
meaning: Good people are rare. Value the ones you find.

sanskrit:
बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते ।
तस्माद्योगाय युज्यस्व योगः कर्मसु कौशलम् ॥
english: One whose understanding is steady leaves behind both good and bad deeds, even here. So give yourself to yoga: yoga is skill in action.
meaning: A steady mind is what makes your work skilful.

sanskrit:
श्लोकेन वा तदर्धेन तदर्धार्धाक्षरेण वा ।
अबन्ध्यं दिवसं कुर्याद्दानाध्ययनकर्मभिः ॥
english: Don't let a day go to waste. Learn a verse, half a verse, a quarter, even a single letter, and fill it with giving, study and good work.
meaning: Use every day well, even if you only learn a little.

sanskrit:
प्रजहाति यदा कामान्सर्वान्पार्थ मनोगतान् ।
आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टः स्थितप्रज्ञस्तदोच्यते ॥
english: When a person lets go of every craving in the mind and is content in the Self, by the Self, they are called steady in wisdom.
meaning: Wisdom is being content within, not chasing more.

sanskrit:
विपदः सन्तु ताः शश्वत्तत्र तत्र जगद्गुरो ।
भवतो दर्शनं यत्स्यादपुनर्भवदर्शनम् ॥
english: Let hardships come again and again, O Teacher of the world, if in each of them I get to see You: the sight that ends the round of rebirth.
meaning: Hard times can bring you closer to God.

sanskrit:
दुःखेष्वनुद्विग्नमनाः सुखेषु विगतस्पृहः ।
वीतरागभयक्रोधः स्थितधीर्मुनिरुच्यते ॥
english: Not shaken by sorrow, not hungry for pleasure, free of attachment, fear and anger: such a person is called a sage of steady mind.
meaning: A calm mind isn't thrown by sorrow or by pleasure.

sanskrit:
दुर्जनस्य च सर्पस्य वरं सर्पो न दुर्जनः ।
सर्पो दंशति काले तु दुर्जनस्तु पदे पदे ॥
english: Between a wicked person and a snake, the snake is better: a snake bites only when its time comes, the wicked one at every step.
meaning: A cruel person can do more harm than a snake. Keep your distance.

sanskrit:
यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वशः ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता ॥
english: Like a tortoise drawing in its limbs, one who can draw the senses back from what pulls at them has wisdom that stands firm.
meaning: Wisdom is being able to pull back from what tempts you.

sanskrit:
प्रलये भिन्नमर्यादा भवन्ति किल सागराः ।
सागरा भेदमिच्छन्ति प्रलयेऽपि न साधवः ॥
english: At the end of an age even the oceans break their shores. Good people never break their bounds, not even then.
meaning: Good people keep their limits even when everything else breaks down.

sanskrit:
ध्यायतो विषयान्पुंसः सङ्गस्तेषूपजायते ।
सङ्गात्सञ्जायते कामः कामात्क्रोधोऽभिजायते ॥
english: Keep dwelling on things and attachment to them grows. Attachment gives birth to desire, and desire gives birth to anger.
meaning: What you keep thinking about, you start to want, and frustrated wanting turns to anger.

sanskrit:
चलत्येकेन पादेन तिष्ठत्येकेन बुद्धिमान् ।
न परीक्ष्य परं स्थानं पूर्वमायतनं त्यजेत् ॥
english: The wise move one foot while keeping the other planted. Don't leave your old place before you have looked over the new one.
meaning: Don't give up what you have until you've checked what comes next.

sanskrit:
रूपयौवनसम्पन्ना विशालकुलसम्भवाः ।
विद्याहीना न शोभन्ते निर्गन्धाः किंशुका यथा ॥
english: Beauty, youth and a great family name don't shine without learning, like palash flowers: bright, but without fragrance.
meaning: Looks and status mean little without learning.

sanskrit:
क्रोधाद्भवति सम्मोहः सम्मोहात्स्मृतिविभ्रमः ।
स्मृतिभ्रंशाद् बुद्धिनाशो बुद्धिनाशात्प्रणश्यति ॥
english: Anger brings confusion, confusion scatters memory, a scattered memory ruins understanding, and when understanding is lost, a person is lost.
meaning: Anger clouds the mind, and a clouded mind makes bad choices.

sanskrit:
उद्योगे नास्ति दारिद्र्यं जपतो नास्ति पातकम् ।
मौनेन कलहो नास्ति नास्ति जागरिते भयम् ॥
english: Effort keeps poverty away, prayer keeps wrongdoing away, silence keeps quarrels away, and alertness keeps fear away.
meaning: Effort, prayer, silence and alertness each keep a trouble away.

sanskrit:
प्रसादे सर्वदुःखानां हानिरस्योपजायते ।
प्रसन्नचेतसो ह्याशु बुद्धिः पर्यवतिष्ठते ॥
english: In that inner calm, every sorrow falls away. For one whose heart is clear, understanding soon becomes steady.
meaning: When the heart is calm, sorrow fades and the mind grows clear.

sanskrit:
असारसंसारविवर्तनेषु मा यात तोषं प्रसभं ब्रवीमि ।
सर्वत्र दैत्याः समतामुपैत समत्वमाराधनमच्युतस्य ॥
english: Don't take delight in the empty turns of this world, I tell you plainly. Look on all as equal everywhere: evenness of mind is itself the worship of God.
meaning: Treating everyone equally is itself a form of worship.

sanskrit:
नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना ।
न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम् ॥
english: Without inner discipline there is no clear understanding and no deep reflection. Without reflection there is no peace. Without peace, where is happiness?
meaning: Without a calm, disciplined mind there is no peace, and without peace no happiness.

sanskrit:
को हि भारः समर्थानां किं दूरं व्यवसायिनाम् ।
को विदेशः सुविद्यानां कः परः प्रियवादिनाम् ॥
english: What is too heavy for the capable? What is too far for the determined? What land is foreign to the learned? Who is a stranger to the kind-spoken?
meaning: With ability, resolve, learning and kind words, nothing is out of reach.

sanskrit:
आपूर्यमाणमचलप्रतिष्ठं
समुद्रमापः प्रविशन्ति यद्वत् ।
तद्वत्कामा यं प्रविशन्ति सर्वे
स शान्तिमाप्नोति न कामकामी ॥
english: Rivers keep pouring into the ocean, yet it stays full and still. One whom desires enter like that finds peace, not one who chases desires.
meaning: Peace comes from staying steady as wants come and go, not from chasing them.

sanskrit:
एकेनापि सुवृक्षेण पुष्पितेन सुगन्धिना ।
वासितं तद्वनं सर्वं सुपुत्रेण कुलं यथा ॥
english: One flowering, fragrant tree perfumes a whole forest. In the same way, one worthy child brings fragrance to a whole family.
meaning: One good person can lift a whole family.

sanskrit:
विहाय कामान्यः सर्वान्पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति ॥
english: One who sets aside every craving and moves through life free of longing, without 'mine' and without ego, comes to peace.
meaning: Let go of craving and ego, and you find peace.

sanskrit:
अद्रोहः सर्वभूतेषु मैत्रीं कुर्याच्च पण्डितः ।
वर्जयेदसतीं वाचमतिवादांस्तथैव च ॥
english: Bear ill will toward no being, and offer friendship. Steer clear of untrue words and of hurtful, excessive talk.
meaning: Wish no one harm, be friendly, and speak truthfully and gently.

sanskrit:
दर्शनध्यानसंस्पर्शैर्मत्सी कूर्मी च पक्षिणी ।
शिशुं पालयते नित्यं तथा सज्जनसङ्गतिः ॥
english: As a fish, a tortoise and a bird care for their young by sight, by thought and by touch, the company of good people cares for us.
meaning: Good company looks after you the way a parent looks after a child.

sanskrit:
नियतं कुरु कर्म त्वं कर्म ज्यायो ह्यकर्मणः ।
शरीरयात्रापि च ते न प्रसिद्ध्येदकर्मणः ॥
english: Do the work that is yours to do; action is better than inaction. Without action you could not even keep your body going.
meaning: Doing your duty is better than doing nothing.

sanskrit:
कामधेनुगुणा विद्या ह्यकाले फलदायिनी ।
प्रवासे मातृसदृशी विद्या गुप्तं धनं स्मृतम् ॥
english: Learning is like the wish-fulfilling cow: it gives even out of season. Far from home it looks after you like a mother. It is hidden wealth.
meaning: Learning is wealth that looks after you anywhere.

sanskrit:
तस्मादसक्तः सततं कार्यं कर्म समाचर ।
असक्तो ह्याचरन्कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः ॥
english: So, without attachment, keep doing the work that needs doing. By acting without attachment, a person reaches the highest.
meaning: Keep doing what needs doing, without clinging to the outcome.

sanskrit:
यथा तरोर्मूलनिषेचनेन तृप्यन्ति तत्स्कन्धभुजोपशाखाः ।
प्राणोपहाराच्च यथेन्द्रियाणां तथैव सर्वार्हणमच्युतेज्या ॥
english: Water a tree's root and its trunk and branches are all nourished; feed the life-breath and every sense is fed. So, worshipping the Divine honours all.
meaning: Honour the root, God, and you honour everything that grows from it.

sanskrit:
यद्यदाचरति श्रेष्ठस्तत्तदेवेतरो जनः ।
स यत्प्रमाणं कुरुते लोकस्तदनुवर्तते ॥
english: Whatever the best among us do, others follow. Whatever standard they set, the world goes along with it.
meaning: People follow the example you set, so set a good one.

sanskrit:
एकोऽपि गुणवान्पुत्रो निर्गुणेन शतेन किम् ।
एकश्चन्द्रस्तमो हन्ति न च ताराः सहस्रशः ॥
english: One child with good qualities is worth more than a hundred without. One moon dispels the dark; thousands of stars do not.
meaning: Quality matters more than quantity.

sanskrit:
काम एष क्रोध एष रजोगुणसमुद्भवः ।
महाशनो महापाप्मा विद्ध्येनमिह वैरिणम् ॥
english: It is desire, it is anger, born of restless passion: never satisfied and the root of much wrong. Know this to be the enemy here.
meaning: Desire and anger are the real enemy within.

sanskrit:
कः कालः कानि मित्राणि को देशः कौ व्ययागमौ ।
कश्चाहं का च मे शक्तिरिति चिन्त्यं मुहुर्मुहुः ॥
english: Ask yourself again and again: What time is it? Who are my friends? Where am I? What comes in and what goes out? Who am I, and what is my strength?
meaning: Keep asking where you stand, who your friends are and what you can do.

sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
english: Whenever goodness fades and wrongdoing rises, I bring Myself forth into the world.
meaning: Whenever goodness is in danger, the Divine steps in to restore it.

sanskrit:
कदर्थितस्यापि हि धैर्यवृत्तेर्न शक्यते सर्वगुणप्रमाथः ।
अधः खलेनापि कृतस्य वह्नेर्नाधः शिखा याति कदाचिदेव ॥
english: Even when harassed, a person of steady courage can't be stripped of their goodness. Turn a flame upside down and it still burns upward.
meaning: A good person stays good, however hard they are pushed.

sanskrit:
यथा चतुर्भिः कनकं परीक्ष्यते
निघर्षणच्छेदनतापताडनैः ।
तथा चतुर्भिः पुरुषः परीक्ष्यते
त्यागेन शीलेन गुणेन कर्मणा ॥
english: Gold is tested four ways: rubbing, cutting, heating and beating. A person is tested four ways too: by generosity, conduct, qualities and deeds.
meaning: A person is known by their generosity, conduct, qualities and deeds.

sanskrit:
ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् ।
मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ॥
english: However people approach Me, I receive them in that same way. Everywhere, people are walking My path.
meaning: God meets everyone in the way they come, so every sincere path leads there.

sanskrit:
एकोदरसमुद्भूता एकनक्षत्रजातकाः ।
न भवन्ति समाः शीले यथा बदरकण्टकाः ॥
english: Born of the same mother, even under the same birth star, people are not alike in character, like the berries and thorns of one bush.
meaning: Even siblings can be very different. Judge each person on their own.

sanskrit:
ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्म हविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् ।
ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना ॥
english: The offering is the Divine, the oblation is the Divine, poured by the Divine into the Divine fire. One who sees the Divine in every act reaches the Divine.
meaning: See the sacred in everything you do, and your work becomes worship.

sanskrit:
श्रवणं कीर्तनं विष्णोः स्मरणं पादसेवनम् ।
अर्चनं वन्दनं दास्यं सख्यमात्मनिवेदनम् ॥
english: Devotion has nine forms: hearing of Vishnu, singing of Him, remembering Him, serving His feet, worship, bowing down, service, friendship, and offering your whole self.
meaning: Every sincere way of turning to God, big or small, counts as devotion.

sanskrit:
अभ्यासाद्धार्यते विद्या कुलं शीलेन धार्यते ।
गुणेन ज्ञायते त्वार्यः कोपो नेत्रेण गम्यते ॥
english: Learning is kept alive by practice, a family's name by good conduct. A noble person is known by their qualities, and anger shows in the eyes.
meaning: Practice keeps learning alive, and good conduct keeps a good name.

sanskrit:
तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया ।
उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ॥
english: Learn it through humble respect, honest questions and service. The wise, who have seen the truth, will teach you.
meaning: Learn from the wise with humility, questions and service.

sanskrit:
दारिद्र्यनाशनं दानं शीलं दुर्गतिनाशनम् ।
अज्ञाननाशिनी प्रज्ञा भावना भयनाशिनी ॥
english: Giving ends poverty, good conduct ends misfortune, wisdom ends ignorance, and steady reflection ends fear.
meaning: Giving, good conduct, wisdom and reflection overcome life's troubles.

sanskrit:
अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः ।
सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि ॥
english: Even if you were the worst wrongdoer of all, the raft of knowledge alone would carry you across every wrong.
meaning: It's never too late. Understanding can carry anyone past their mistakes.

sanskrit:
न सर्ववित्कश्चिदिहास्ति लोके नात्यन्तमूर्खो भुवि चापि कश्चित् ।
ज्ञानेन नीचोत्तममध्यमेन योऽयं विजानाति स तेन विद्वान् ॥
english: No one here knows everything, and no one is a complete fool. Whatever a person knows, humble, middling or high, in that they are learned.
meaning: Everyone knows something worth learning from.

sanskrit:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते ।
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति ॥
english: Nothing in this world purifies like knowledge. One made whole through yoga finds it within, in time.
meaning: Nothing cleanses the mind like true understanding.

sanskrit:
सत्येन धार्यते पृथ्वी सत्येन तपते रविः ।
सत्येन वाति वायुश्च सर्वं सत्ये प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
english: By truth the earth is upheld, by truth the sun shines, by truth the wind blows. Everything rests on truth.
meaning: Truth holds the whole world together.

sanskrit:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः ।
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति ॥
english: One who has faith, gives themselves to it and masters the senses gains knowledge, and having gained it, soon finds the highest peace.
meaning: Faith, dedication and self-control lead to knowledge and peace.

sanskrit:
स्वयं कर्म करोत्यात्मा स्वयं तत्फलमश्नुते ।
स्वयं भ्रमति संसारे स्वयं तस्माद्विमुच्यते ॥
english: The self does its own deeds and tastes their fruit itself. It wanders through the world on its own, and on its own it is set free.
meaning: You live with your own choices, and you find your own freedom.

sanskrit:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः ।
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा ॥
english: One who acts without clinging and offers every act to the Divine is untouched by wrong, as a lotus leaf is untouched by water.
meaning: Work done as an offering leaves you untouched, like water on a lotus leaf.

sanskrit:
तत्कर्म यन्न बन्धाय सा विद्या या विमुक्तये ।
आयासायापरं कर्म विद्यान्या शिल्पनैपुणम् ॥
english: True action is action that doesn't bind; true knowledge is knowledge that sets you free. Other action is only toil; other knowledge only a craft.
meaning: The best work and learning are the kinds that set you free.

sanskrit:
प्रभूतं कार्यमल्पं वा यन्नरः कर्तुमिच्छति ।
सर्वारम्भेण तत्कार्यं सिंहादेकं प्रचक्षते ॥
english: Whatever you set out to do, big or small, do it with your whole effort. That is the one lesson to learn from the lion.
meaning: Whatever you do, give it everything.

sanskrit:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् ।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति ॥
english: Knowing Me as the one who receives every offering and discipline, the great Lord of all worlds and the friend of every being, a person finds peace.
meaning: Knowing God as everyone's friend brings peace.

sanskrit:
सन्तोषामृततृप्तानां यत्सुखं शान्तिरेव च ।
न च तद्धनलुब्धानामितश्चेतश्च धावताम् ॥
english: The peace and joy of those filled with the nectar of contentment never come to those who run here and there, greedy for money.
meaning: Contentment brings a peace that money can't buy.

sanskrit:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
english: Lift yourself up by your own effort; don't let yourself sink. You alone are your own friend, and you alone can be your own enemy.
meaning: Lift yourself up. You can be your own best friend or your worst enemy.

sanskrit:
या देवी सर्वभूतेषु शान्तिरूपेण संस्थिता ।
नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमस्तस्यै नमो नमः ॥
english: To the Goddess who dwells in every being as peace: salutations to Her, salutations to Her, salutations to Her, again and again.
meaning: A prayer to the Goddess who lives in every being as peace.

sanskrit:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः ।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत् ॥
english: For one who has mastered themselves, the self is a friend. For one who has not, their own self behaves like an enemy.
meaning: Master yourself and your own mind becomes your friend.

sanskrit:
न देवो विद्यते काष्ठे न पाषाणे न मृन्मये ।
भावे हि विद्यते देवस्तस्माद्भावो हि कारणम् ॥
english: God is not in wood, nor in stone, nor in clay. God lives in heartfelt devotion, so it is the feeling within that truly matters.
meaning: God is found in a sincere heart, not in idols alone.

sanskrit:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु ।
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते ॥
english: One who looks with the same even mind on well-wishers, friends, foes, strangers, rivals, relatives, the good and the wrongdoers stands out.
meaning: Treat friends, strangers and rivals with the same fairness.

sanskrit:
गुणो भूषयते रूपं शीलं भूषयते कुलम् ।
सिद्धिर्भूषयते विद्यां भोगो भूषयते धनम् ॥
english: Virtue adorns beauty, good conduct adorns a family, accomplishment adorns learning, and putting it to good use adorns wealth.
meaning: Every gift shines brighter when it is used well.

sanskrit:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा ॥
english: For one who is balanced in eating and in play, balanced in effort at work, balanced in sleep and in waking, yoga becomes the end of sorrow.
meaning: Balance in food, rest, work and play brings peace.

sanskrit:
मुक्तिमिच्छसि चेत्तात विषयान्विषवत्त्यज ।
क्षमार्जवदयाशौचं सत्यं पीयूषवत्पिब ॥
english: If you want freedom, my friend, leave sense-cravings like poison, and drink in patience, honesty, kindness, purity and truth like nectar.
meaning: Let go of cravings and choose patience, honesty, kindness and truth.

sanskrit:
न कामयेऽहं गतिमीश्वरात्परामष्टर्द्धियुक्तामपुनर्भवं वा ।
आर्तिं प्रपद्येऽखिलदेहभाजामन्तःस्थितो येन भवन्त्यदुःखाः ॥
english: I don't ask God for the highest state, its powers, or release from rebirth. I would take on the pain of all beings, so that they may be free of sorrow.
meaning: The highest wish is to ease others' suffering.

sanskrit:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः ॥
english: Like a lamp in a windless place that does not flicker: that is the picture of a disciplined mind absorbed in meditation.
meaning: A focused mind is as steady as a flame where there is no wind.

sanskrit:
दरिद्रता धीरतया विराजते
कुवस्त्रता शुभ्रतया विराजते ।
कदन्नता चोष्णतया विराजते
कुरूपता शीलतया विराजते ॥
english: Poverty shines through courage, plain clothes through cleanliness, simple food when served warm, and plain looks through good character.
meaning: Courage and good character make up for what you lack.

sanskrit:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत् ॥
english: Wherever the restless, unsteady mind wanders off to, gently bring it back from there and settle it within the Self.
meaning: When your mind wanders, gently bring it back.

sanskrit:
धीराः कष्टमनुप्राप्य न भवन्ति विषादिनः ।
प्रविश्य वदनं राहोः किं नोदति पुनः शशी ॥
english: The steady don't despair when hardship comes. Doesn't the moon rise again after Rahu swallows it?
meaning: Hard times pass, as the moon comes back after an eclipse.

sanskrit:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति ॥
english: One who sees Me everywhere and sees everything in Me: I am never lost to them, and they are never lost to Me.
meaning: See the Divine in everything, and you are never alone.

sanskrit:
धनहीनो न हीनश्च धनिकः स सुनिश्चयः ।
विद्यारत्नेन हीनो यः स हीनः सर्ववस्तुषु ॥
english: Lacking money doesn't make you lacking; such a person may still be truly rich. One who lacks the jewel of learning lacks in everything.
meaning: Without learning you are truly poor, whatever your money.

sanskrit:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः ॥
english: One who sees every being as they see themselves, feeling others' joy and sorrow as their own, is counted the highest yogi.
meaning: Feel others' joy and pain as your own.

sanskrit:
सुखार्थी चेत्त्यजेद्विद्यां विद्यार्थी चेत्त्यजेत्सुखम् ।
सुखार्थिनः कुतो विद्या सुखं विद्यार्थिनः कुतः ॥
english: If you want comfort, give up learning; if you want learning, give up comfort. Where is learning for the comfort-seeker, or comfort for the learner?
meaning: Real learning takes effort. Comfort and study rarely go together.

sanskrit:
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते ॥
english: Yes, the mind is restless and hard to hold. But with steady practice and letting go, it can be held.
meaning: The mind is restless, but practice and letting go can steady it.

sanskrit:
यस्य नास्ति स्वयं प्रज्ञा शास्त्रं तस्य करोति किम् ।
लोचनाभ्यां विहीनस्य दर्पणः किं करिष्यति ॥
english: What can books do for someone with no understanding of their own? What can a mirror do for someone without eyes?
meaning: Books help only those willing to think for themselves.

sanskrit:
एतावज्जन्मसाफल्यं देहिनामिह देहिषु ।
प्राणैरर्थैर्धिया वाचा श्रेयआचरणं सदा ॥
english: This is what makes a life worthwhile: always doing good for others with your life, your means, your understanding and your words.
meaning: A life is worthwhile when it is spent doing good for others.

sanskrit:
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद् दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति ॥
english: No one who does good ever comes to a bad end, dear one, neither in this world nor the next.
meaning: No one who does good ever comes to a bad end.

sanskrit:
बुद्धिर्यस्य बलं तस्य निर्बुद्धेश्च कुतो बलम् ।
वने सिंहो यदोन्मत्तः शशकेन निपातितः ॥
english: Intelligence is strength; without it, where is strength? In the forest, a proud and reckless lion was brought down by a hare.
meaning: Wit beats brute strength.

sanskrit:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
english: Those who think of Me alone and worship Me, always devoted: I bring them what they lack and keep safe what they have.
meaning: God looks after those who keep Him in their heart.

sanskrit:
दातृत्वं प्रियवक्तृत्वं धीरत्वमुचितज्ञता ।
अभ्यासेन न लभ्यन्ते चत्वारः सहजा गुणाः ॥
english: Generosity, kind speech, courage and a sense of what is fitting are not gained by practice. These four are inborn.
meaning: Generosity, kind words, courage and good sense come from within.

sanskrit:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥
english: A leaf, a flower, a fruit, a little water: whatever is offered to Me with love by a sincere heart, I gladly accept.
meaning: What matters is the love behind a gift, not its size.

sanskrit:
वनेऽपि दोषाः प्रभवन्ति रागिणां गृहेऽपि पञ्चेन्द्रियनिग्रहस्तपः ।
अकुत्सिते कर्मणि यः प्रवर्तते निवृत्तरागस्य गृहं तपोवनम् ॥
english: For a craving mind, faults arise even in the forest. At home, mastering the senses is itself austerity. For one free of craving, doing honest work, home is a hermitage.
meaning: A disciplined mind makes any home a sacred place.

sanskrit:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥
english: I am the same to all beings; no one is hateful or dear to Me. But those who worship Me with love are in Me, and I am in them.
meaning: God is the same to all, and close to those who love Him.

sanskrit:
सत्सङ्गाद्भवति हि साधुना खलानां
साधूनां नहि खलसङ्गतः खलत्वम् ।
आमोदं कुसुमभवं मृदेव धत्ते
मृद्गन्धं नहि कुसुमानि धारयन्ति ॥
english: In good company even the unkind grow good, but the good don't turn bad in bad company. Earth takes on a flower's fragrance; flowers never smell of earth.
meaning: Good company lifts you, and good people don't sink in bad company.

sanskrit:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति ।
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति ॥
english: Soon they become good at heart and reach lasting peace. Know this for certain: one who loves Me is never lost.
meaning: One who loves God is never lost.

sanskrit:
साधूनां दर्शनं पुण्यं तीर्थभूता हि साधवः ।
कालेन फलते तीर्थं सद्यः साधुसमागमः ॥
english: Just seeing good people is a blessing; they are living places of pilgrimage. A pilgrimage bears fruit in time, good company at once.
meaning: Time with good people blesses you at once.

sanskrit:
सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये शिवे सर्वार्थसाधिके ।
शरण्ये त्र्यम्बके गौरि नारायणि नमोऽस्तु ते ॥
english: O auspicious one, the blessing within every blessing, who brings every aim to fulfilment, our refuge, three-eyed Gauri, Narayani: salutations to you.
meaning: A prayer of thanks to the Goddess who fulfils every good wish.

sanskrit:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥
english: I am the Self, seated in the heart of every being. I am their beginning, their middle and their end.
meaning: The Divine lives in the heart of every being.

sanskrit:
सत्यं माता पिता ज्ञानं धर्मो भ्राता दया सखा ।
शान्तिः पत्नी क्षमा पुत्रः षडेते मम बान्धवाः ॥
english: Truth is my mother, knowledge my father, dharma my brother, compassion my friend, peace my spouse, forgiveness my child. These six are my family.
meaning: Truth, knowledge, kindness, peace and forgiveness are a family for life.

sanskrit:
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
english: Always content, self-controlled, firm in resolve, with mind and understanding given to Me: that devotee is dear to Me.
meaning: Contentment, self-control and devotion make a person dear to God.

sanskrit:
जलबिन्दुनिपातेन क्रमशः पूर्यते घटः ।
स हेतुः सर्वविद्यानां धर्मस्य च धनस्य च ॥
english: Drop by drop, a pot is filled. That is the secret of all learning, of goodness and of wealth.
meaning: Small steady efforts add up to great things.

sanskrit:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः ।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः ॥
english: One who troubles no one and is not troubled by anyone, free from elation, envy, fear and anxiety: that person is dear to Me.
meaning: Bring no one trouble, and don't let others trouble you.

sanskrit:
कायेन वाचा मनसेन्द्रियैर्वा बुद्ध्यात्मना वानुसृतस्वभावात् ।
करोति यद्यत्सकलं परस्मै नारायणायेति समर्पयेत्तत् ॥
english: Whatever you do, with body, speech, mind, senses, intellect or by your own nature, offer all of it to the Divine, saying: this is for Narayana.
meaning: Offer everything you do to God.

sanskrit:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित् ।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः ॥
english: Even in blame and praise, quiet, content with whatever comes, not tied to one place, steady in mind and full of devotion: that person is dear to Me.
meaning: Stay calm and content, whether you are praised or blamed.

sanskrit:
गते शोको न कर्तव्यो भविष्यं नैव चिन्तयेत् ।
वर्तमानेन कालेन वर्तयन्ति विचक्षणाः ॥
english: Don't grieve over what is past, and don't brood over what is to come. The wise live by the present moment.
meaning: Live in the present. Don't dwell on the past or worry about the future.

sanskrit:
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम् ।
दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम् ॥
english: A good and godly nature shows in non-violence, truth, no anger, letting go, calm, no backbiting, kindness to all, no greed, gentleness, modesty and steadiness.
meaning: Kindness, honesty and calm are the signs of a good heart.

sanskrit:
बन्धाय विषयासङ्गो मुक्त्यै निर्विषयं मनः ।
मन एव मनुष्याणां कारणं बन्धमोक्षयोः ॥
english: Clinging to sense-pleasures binds; a mind free of them is free. The mind alone is the cause of a person's bondage and freedom.
meaning: Your own mind binds you, and your own mind sets you free.

sanskrit:
विप्राणां भूषणं विद्या पृथिव्या भूषणं नृपः ।
नभसो भूषणं चन्द्रः शीलं सर्वस्य भूषणम् ॥
english: Learning adorns the scholar, a good ruler adorns the land, the moon adorns the sky, but good character adorns everyone.
meaning: Good character is the finest ornament.

sanskrit:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः ।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत् ॥
english: Desire, anger and greed: these three are the gateways to one's own ruin. So let all three go.
meaning: Desire, anger and greed lead to ruin. Let them go.

sanskrit:
यथा धेनुसहस्रेषु वत्सो गच्छति मातरम् ।
तथा यच्च कृतं कर्म कर्तारमनुगच्छति ॥
english: As a calf finds its own mother among a thousand cows, the deeds a person has done find their way back to the doer.
meaning: Your actions always come back to you.

sanskrit:
सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत ।
श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः ॥
english: Everyone's faith takes the shape of their nature. A person is made of their faith: as their faith is, so are they.
meaning: You become what you truly believe in.

sanskrit:
पृथिव्यां त्रीणि रत्नानि जलमन्नं सुभाषितम् ।
मूढैः पाषाणखण्डेषु रत्नसञ्ज्ञा विधीयते ॥
english: The earth has three jewels: water, food and wise words. Only the foolish call pieces of stone jewels.
meaning: Water, food and wise words are the real treasures.

sanskrit:
अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् ।
स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते ॥
english: Words that hurt no one and are true, kind and helpful, along with regular study: this is called the discipline of speech.
meaning: Speak words that are true, kind and helpful.

sanskrit:
नामसङ्कीर्तनं यस्य सर्वपाप प्रणाशनम् ।
प्रणामो दुःखशमनस्तं नमामि हरिं परम् ॥
english: I bow to Hari, the Supreme, whose name, sung aloud, washes away every wrong, and to whom a simple bow brings sorrow to rest.
meaning: Remembering God's name eases sorrow and clears the heart.

sanskrit:
मनः प्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः ।
भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते ॥
english: A clear and calm mind, gentleness, silence, self-control and a pure heart: this is called the discipline of the mind.
meaning: A calm, gentle and pure mind is its own discipline.

sanskrit:
बहूनां चैव सत्त्वानां समवायो रिपुञ्जयः ।
वर्षाधाराधरो मेघस्तृणैरपि निवार्यते ॥
english: Many together can overcome any foe. Even blades of grass, woven together, hold back the rain of a storm cloud.
meaning: Together, even the weak become strong.

sanskrit:
दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे ।
देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ॥
english: A gift given simply because giving is right, to one who cannot repay, at the right place and time, to a worthy person: that is pure giving.
meaning: The purest giving expects nothing in return.

sanskrit:
दाने तपसि शौर्ये वा विज्ञाने विनये नये ।
विस्मयो नहि कर्तव्यो बहुरत्ना वसुन्धरा ॥
english: Never be too amazed by anyone's generosity, discipline, courage, knowledge, humility or good judgement. The earth holds many jewels.
meaning: Don't be overawed by anyone. The world is full of gifted people.

sanskrit:
नाल्पा भवति सद्विद्या दीयमानापि वर्धते ।
कूपस्थमिव पानीयं भवत्येव बहूदकम् ॥
english: True learning never runs low; it grows as you give it away, like water in a well that keeps filling as it is drawn.
meaning: Knowledge grows the more you share it.

sanskrit:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥
english: The One from whom all beings arise and who pervades all this: by honouring Him through your own work, you find fulfilment.
meaning: Doing your own work well is a way of honouring God.

sanskrit:
दूरस्थोऽपि न दूरस्थो यो यस्य मनसि स्थितः ।
यो यस्य हृदये नास्ति समीपस्थोऽपि दूरतः ॥
english: One who lives in your heart is never far, even far away. One who is not in your heart is distant, even standing beside you.
meaning: Closeness lives in the heart, not in distance.

sanskrit:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः ॥
english: Don't abandon the work that is natural to you, even if it has flaws. Every undertaking carries some flaw, as fire comes wrapped in smoke.
meaning: No work is perfect, so do your own work anyway.

sanskrit:
अनन्तशास्त्रं बहुलाश्च विद्याः
स्वल्पश्च कालो बहुविघ्नता च ।
यत्सारभूतं तदुपासनीयं
हंसो यथा क्षीरमिवाम्बुमध्यात् ॥
english: Scriptures are endless and branches of learning many, but time is short and obstacles are many. Take the essence, as the swan draws milk from water.
meaning: Life is short, so take the essence and leave the rest.

sanskrit:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया ।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥
english: I have shared with you wisdom deeper than any secret. Reflect on it fully, then do as you choose.
meaning: Think it through for yourself, then choose.

sanskrit:
न प्रहृष्यति सम्मानैर्नावमानैः प्रकुप्यति ।
न क्रुद्धः परुषं ब्रूयादेतत्साधोस्तु लक्षणम् ॥
english: Not puffed up by honour, not angered by insult, and never harsh in speech even when angry: these are the marks of a good person.
meaning: Stay humble with praise, calm with insult and gentle in speech.

sanskrit:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
english: Let go of every other duty and take refuge in Me alone. I will free you from all wrongs. Do not grieve.
meaning: Surrender to God and let go of fear.

sanskrit:
दानेन पाणिर्न तु कङ्कणेन
स्नानेन शुद्धिर्न तु चन्दनेन ।
मानेन तृप्तिर्न तु भोजनेन
ज्ञानेन मुक्तिर्न तु मण्डनेन ॥
english: Hands are graced by giving, not bangles; you are cleansed by bathing, not sandal paste; fed by respect, not food; freed by knowledge, not finery.
meaning: Giving, respect and knowledge matter more than outward show.
